highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and async pixel reads alongside the Skia m152 engine update.
highlights_body: It also strengthens native-object lifetime handling, improves common data paths, adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and expands Nano Server font support.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer advances through the m151 and m152 upstream servicing syncs, including the Chrome m152 use-after-free correction.
New bindings expose Skia's Graphite backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn integrations.
SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel readback across graphics backends.

bullets.lead: Native-backed objects retain their pixel and region sources
bullets.detail: SKRegion iterators and SKPixmap subsets now keep their backing objects alive, preventing native use-after-free failures.

bullets.lead: Raster creation cleans up failed allocations
bullets.detail: SKImage raster creation now releases its CoTaskMem pixel buffer when native construction fails.

bullets.lead: Faster managed data and uniform paths
bullets.detail: SKData.SaveTo, encoded-text access, runtime-effect uniform lookup, handle registration, and tag formatting avoid unnecessary copies, allocations, or reflection.

bullets.lead: Runtime-effect uniform reset releases prior buffers
bullets.detail: Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms disposes the previous uniform buffer instead of retaining native resources.
SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET is produced again, providing a maintained package path for Silk.NET Vulkan applications.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support uses FreeType
bullets.detail: Nano Server native assets use FreeType so applications have bundled font support on that target.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed Nano Server font support
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, memory-lifetime fixes, and the Vulkan Silk.NET package.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added the latest m152 servicing sync, Apple native symbol packages, runtime-effect lifetime fixes, and managed performance improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp improves Font.Shape by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and shares the release's updated package documentation and native packaging work.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and the Skia m152 engine update.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds asynchronous pixel reads, fixes native object lifetime issues, and restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 refreshes the m152 engine and native package output.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It includes Apple native symbol packages, runtime-effect lifetime fixes, and managed performance improvements.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 is the stable release with Graphite bindings and the Skia m152 engine.
v4.152.0.body: It delivers the preview and release-candidate improvements as the 4.152 stable line.
